model.name: Restaurants
model.description: Restaurants is a global foodservice industry operating quick-service, casual, and fine-dining establishments through franchise and company-owned models, serving millions of customers daily with a focus on speed, quality, and value.
model.core_business_processes: Menu Development and Engineering, Food Procurement and Supply Chain Management, Restaurant Operations and Service Delivery, Franchise Management and Development, Quality Assurance and Food Safety Compliance, Customer Order Management and Fulfillment, Workforce Scheduling and Labor Management, Marketing and Promotional Campaign Execution, Financial Planning and Revenue Management, Real Estate Site Selection and Facility Management
model.data_domains: Menu, Guest, Order, Supply Chain, Restaurant Operations, Workforce, Franchise, Marketing, Finance, Food Safety, Inventory, Loyalty, Real Estate
model.common_business_jargons: QSR (Quick-Service Restaurant), COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), AUV (Average Unit Volume), PMIX (Product Mix), BOH (Back of House), FOH (Front of House), POS (Point of Sale), KDS (Kitchen Display System), LTO (Limited Time Offer), HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points), SOP (Standard Operating Procedure), FTE (Full-Time Equivalent), ADT (Average Daily Transactions), ATC (Average Transaction Count), ACV (Average Check Value), SSS (Same-Store Sales), NRO (New Restaurant Opening), CSAT (Customer Satisfaction), NPS (Net Promoter Score), DT (Drive-Thru), OLO (Online Ordering), 3PD (Third-Party Delivery), SKU (Stock Keeping Unit), BOM (Bill of Materials), R&M (Repairs and Maintenance), P&L (Profit and Loss), EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization), ROI (Return on Investment), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), WMS (Warehouse Management System), GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), FDA (Food and Drug Administration), OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), CoGS% (Cost of Goods Sold Percentage), Labor% (Labor Cost Percentage), Speed of Service (SOS), Ticket Time, Daypart, Throughput, Comp Sales (Comparable Store Sales), Franchise Fee, Royalty Rate, CAM (Common Area Maintenance), CapEx (Capital Expenditure), OpEx (Operating Expenditure), PAR Level (Periodic Automatic Replenishment Level), Waste% (Food Waste Percentage), Yield Management, Table Turn, Cover Count
model.operational_systems_of_records: Oracle MICROS POS (order capture; payment processing; menu management), SAP S/4HANA (GL; AP; AR; FA; CO; MM), Workday HCM (recruiting; payroll; benefits; time tracking; workforce planning), MarketMan Inventory Management (stock tracking; purchase orders; vendor management; waste tracking), Salesforce CRM (franchise relations; guest engagement; marketing automation), FranConnect (franchise development; compliance tracking; royalty management; site selection), Olo Digital Ordering Platform (online ordering; delivery integration; guest data), Zenput (food safety audits; task management; operational compliance), Coupa Procurement (sourcing; supplier management; contract management; spend analytics), Planday Workforce Scheduling (shift planning; labor forecasting; time and attendance)
model.industry_governing_body: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) - food safety and labeling regulations, USDA (United States Department of Agriculture) - meat and poultry inspection and grading, OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) - workplace safety standards, FTC (Federal Trade Commission) - franchise disclosure and advertising regulations, NRA (National Restaurant Association) - industry standards and ServSafe certification, Local Health Departments - restaurant inspection and permitting, IFA (International Franchise Association) - franchise best practices and ethics, ISO 22000 - Food Safety Management Systems, PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) - payment data security, GAAP/IFRS - financial reporting standards

domains.name: menu

Governs what the business sells.

domains.name: restaurant
domains.description: Master record for every restaurant unit — company-owned and franchised — including location attributes, format (QSR/casual/fine-dining), FOH/BOH configuration, operating hours, daypart schedules, equipment, throughput capacity, speed-of-service (SOS) benchmarks, table turns, cover counts, AUV, SSS, and comp sales. Operational anchor for brand standards and SOPs.

products.name: unit
products.description: Master record for every restaurant unit — company-owned and franchised. The authoritative identity of each physical location including unit number, brand, concept type (QSR/casual/fine-dining), ownership model (company-owned vs. franchised), legal entity name, trade name, opening date, closure date, current operational status, and geographic coordinates. This is the operational anchor for the entire restaurant domain and the primary FK target for all cross-domain joins (order, inventory, workforce, finance, franchise). One row per physical restaurant location. All other restaurant domain products reference this entity.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the restaurant unit. Primary key for the unit master record.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to restaurant.brand. Business justification: Unit should reference its brand via a foreign key rather than a free‑text code; brand_id provides referential integrity.

attributes.name: brand_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to restaurant.brand_standard. Business justification: Units must be linked to the applicable brand standard for compliance tracking.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to restaurant.department. Business justification: Linking a unit to its department enables organizational reporting and eliminates the department table silo.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.facility. Business justification: Facility‑to‑Unit link required for building‑level maintenance, energy‑rating compliance, and health‑inspection tracking.

attributes.name: landlord_id

products.name: format_config
products.description: Defines the operational format, physical configuration, and total capacity of a restaurant unit. Includes dining format (QSR, fast-casual, casual, fine-dining), service model (counter, table, drive-thru, kiosk), FOH layout (total indoor seating capacity, outdoor/patio seating capacity, bar seating count, private dining room capacity, ADA-compliant seating count, table count, cover count), BOH layout (kitchen footprint sq ft, cooking lines, prep stations), drive-thru configuration (lane count, stacking capacity for vehicles), kiosk count, counter service positions, and maximum cover count per daypart. This is the single source of truth for all physical capacity and layout attributes of a unit — governs brand standard compliance, throughput benchmarking, labor staffing ratios, health department permit compliance, and fire marshal occupancy limits.

attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this operating hours schedule. May include reasons for schedule changes, special instructions, or operational context.

attributes.name: open_time
attributes.description: The time the restaurant opens for the specified day and daypart, in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g., 06:00).

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this operating hours record. Active schedules are in effect; pending schedules are future-dated; expired schedules are past their end date; suspended schedules are temporarily disabled.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: The type of operating hours schedule. Regular for standard weekly hours, holiday for holiday overrides, seasonal for seasonal adjustments, temporary for one-time changes, special_event for event-driven hours.

attributes.name: seasonal_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether these operating hours represent a seasonal adjustment (e.g., extended summer hours, reduced winter hours). True if seasonal, False for standard schedule.

attributes.name: seasonal_period_name
attributes.description: The name of the seasonal period for which this schedule adjustment applies (e.g., Summer, Winter, Back-to-School). Null if not a seasonal adjustment.

attributes.name: special_event_name
attributes.description: The name of the special event for which these operating hours apply (e.g., Super Bowl Sunday, Local Festival, Grand Opening). Null if not a special event schedule.

attributes.name: target_speed_of_service_seconds
attributes.description: The target Speed of Service (SOS) in seconds for this daypart. Represents the benchmark time from order placement to order fulfillment. Used for operational performance tracking.

attributes.name: target_ticket_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target ticket time in seconds for this daypart. Represents the benchmark time from order entry to Kitchen Display System (KDS) completion. Used for Back of House (BOH) performance tracking.

attributes.name: throughput_capacity_per_hour
attributes.description: The estimated number of customer transactions the restaurant can process per hour during this daypart. Used for labor scheduling and Speed of Service (SOS) benchmarking.

products.name: equipment_asset
products.description: Inventory of all BOH and FOH equipment assets installed at each restaurant unit including all equipment types (fryer, grill, oven, KDS stations, POS terminals, refrigeration units, ice machines, espresso machines, drive-thru timers). Captures make, model, serial number, installation date, warranty expiry, last service date, next scheduled maintenance date, asset condition rating, replacement cost, software version (for digital equipment), and equipment-specific configuration attributes. Supports R&M (Repairs and Maintenance) planning, CapEx forecasting, PCI DSS compliance for payment terminals, and food safety compliance for temperature-critical equipment.

attributes.name: equipment_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the equipment asset record. Primary key.

attributes.name: equipment_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where this equipment asset is installed.

attributes.name: equipment_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where this equipment asset is installed.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Asset depreciation and financial reporting require each physical equipment asset to be tied to a fixed‑asset record in finance.

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor or service provider responsible for maintenance and repair of this equipment asset.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost_usd
attributes.description: Original purchase price paid for the equipment asset in US dollars, used for CapEx (Capital Expenditure) tracking and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: asset_condition_rating
attributes.description: Current physical and operational condition assessment of the equipment asset based on inspection and performance criteria.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique asset tag or barcode identifier affixed to the equipment for tracking and inventory purposes.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current compliance certification expires and recertification or inspection is required.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification or approval number from regulatory bodies (FDA, NSF, UL, OSHA) confirming the equipment meets safety and sanitation standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this equipment asset record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the cost of the equipment asset over its useful life for financial reporting and tax purposes.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment asset was decommissioned and removed from the restaurant, marking the end of its operational lifecycle.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the equipment was disposed of at end of life, supporting asset lifecycle tracking and environmental compliance.

attributes.name: energy_rating
attributes.description: Energy efficiency rating or certification (e.g., Energy Star rating) indicating the equipment's power consumption performance.

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: High-level classification grouping equipment by operational domain (cooking, refrigeration, POS systems, etc.). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cooking|refrigeration|food_prep|beverage|pos_system|kitchen_display|sanitation|hvac — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: equipment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the equipment asset (e.g., Fryer Station 1, POS Terminal 3, Walk-in Cooler).

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Category of equipment asset distinguishing its primary function within BOH (Back of House) or FOH (Front of House) operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fryer|grill|oven|refrigeration_unit|freezer|ice_machine|pos_terminal|kds_display|espresso_machine|beverage_dispenser|dishwasher|ventilation_hood|warming_cabinet|prep_table — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the equipment asset was installed and commissioned at the restaurant location.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this equipment asset record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_service_date
attributes.description: Most recent date when preventive maintenance or repair service was performed on this equipment asset.

attributes.name: last_temperature_check_timestamp
attributes.description: Most recent date and time when temperature was verified for temperature-critical equipment, supporting food safety audit trails.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease or rental agreement for this equipment expires, requiring renewal or return of the asset.

attributes.name: location_zone
attributes.description: Physical zone within the restaurant where the equipment is installed: BOH (Back of House), FOH (Front of House), Drive-Thru, Storage, or Outdoor.

attributes.name: maintenance_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled preventive maintenance services as defined by manufacturer guidelines or internal SOPs.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the equipment asset.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned model number or designation for the equipment.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next preventive maintenance service visit based on manufacturer recommendations and SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) schedules.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special handling instructions, or historical context about the equipment asset.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status indicating whether the equipment is actively in use, under maintenance, or retired from service.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is owned outright by the restaurant, leased under a capital or operating lease, or rented short-term.

attributes.name: power_consumption_watts
attributes.description: Rated electrical power consumption of the equipment in watts under normal operating conditions, used for energy cost forecasting.

attributes.name: replacement_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated current market cost to replace this equipment asset with a comparable new unit, used for R&M (Repairs and Maintenance) budgeting and insurance valuation.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific equipment unit for warranty and service tracking.

attributes.name: service_contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the active service or maintenance contract covering this equipment asset, if applicable.

attributes.name: temperature_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this equipment maintains temperature-sensitive food products and requires continuous monitoring for HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_max_f
attributes.description: Maximum safe operating temperature threshold in Fahrenheit for temperature-critical equipment, above which food safety is compromised.

attributes.name: temperature_min_f
attributes.description: Minimum safe operating temperature threshold in Fahrenheit for temperature-critical equipment, below which food safety is compromised.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected operational lifespan of the equipment asset in years, used for depreciation calculations and replacement planning.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage ends, after which repairs and parts are at the restaurant's expense.

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer or vendor warranty coverage begins for this equipment asset.

products.name: throughput_benchmark
products.description: Defines throughput capacity benchmarks and speed-of-service (SOS) targets for each restaurant unit by service channel (DT drive-thru, counter, OLO online, 3PD third-party delivery) and daypart. Captures target ticket time (seconds), target throughput (covers/hour or transactions/hour), ADT (Average Daily Transactions) target, ATC (Average Transaction Count) target, ACV (Average Check Value) target, table turn target (minutes), and cover count capacity. Used for operational performance benchmarking and SOS compliance.
products.reference: SOS Benchmark / Speed of Service Target

attributes.name: throughput_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the throughput benchmark record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the daypart (e.g., breakfast, lunch, dinner, late night) for which this benchmark applies. Links to the daypart reference table.

attributes.name: throughput_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit to which this throughput benchmark applies. Links to the restaurant master record.

attributes.name: throughput_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit to which this throughput benchmark applies. Links to the restaurant master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this throughput benchmark was formally approved for use in operational performance measurement.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operations manager, regional director, or executive who approved this throughput benchmark.

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: Source or origin of the benchmark definition. Corporate_standard = company-wide standard, franchise_agreement = defined in franchise contract, regional_target = regional operations target, unit_specific = customized for individual unit, industry_benchmark = derived from industry standards.

attributes.name: benchmark_type
attributes.description: Classification of the benchmark: target = standard operational target, minimum = minimum acceptable performance, maximum = maximum achievable performance, stretch = aspirational goal for high-performing units.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this throughput benchmark record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date until which this throughput benchmark remains effective. Null indicates the benchmark is currently active with no defined end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this throughput benchmark becomes effective. Supports temporal tracking of benchmark changes over time.

attributes.name: equipment_capacity_constraint
attributes.description: Description of any equipment capacity constraints (e.g., grill capacity, fryer capacity, KDS screen count) that limit throughput for this service channel and daypart.

attributes.name: labor_fte_requirement
attributes.description: Number of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) staff required to achieve the target throughput for this service channel and daypart. Used for workforce scheduling and labor planning.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this throughput benchmark was last reviewed by operations management or performance analysts.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this throughput benchmark record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next review of this throughput benchmark. Calculated based on last_review_date and review_frequency_days.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special considerations for this throughput benchmark. May include information about seasonal adjustments, promotional impacts, or facility-specific factors.

attributes.name: off_peak_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base throughput targets during off-peak hours for this service channel and daypart. Used to adjust capacity expectations during low-demand periods.

attributes.name: peak_hour_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base throughput targets during peak hours for this service channel and daypart. Used to adjust capacity expectations during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: queue_length_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable queue length (number of waiting customers or orders) for this service channel and daypart before operational intervention is required.

attributes.name: restaurant_format
attributes.description: Format classification of the restaurant for which this benchmark applies. QSR = Quick-Service Restaurant, casual = Casual dining, fine_dining = Fine-dining establishment. Benchmarks vary significantly by format.

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Frequency in days at which this throughput benchmark should be reviewed and potentially updated. Supports continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

attributes.name: service_channel
attributes.description: The service channel for which this benchmark is defined. DT = Drive-Thru, counter = Front counter service, OLO = Online Ordering, 3PD = Third-Party Delivery, dine_in = Dine-in service, curbside = Curbside pickup.

attributes.name: sos_compliance_threshold_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Speed of Service (SOS) Compliance Threshold Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage threshold for Speed of Service (SOS) compliance. Represents the minimum percentage of orders that must meet the target ticket time to be considered compliant.

tag_set.value: Speed of Service (SOS) Compliance Threshold Percentage

attributes.name: target_acv
attributes.description: Target Average Check Value (ACV) in local currency for this service channel and daypart. Represents the expected revenue per transaction.

attributes.name: target_adt
attributes.description: Target Average Daily Transactions (ADT) for this service channel and daypart. Represents the expected number of transactions per day.

attributes.name: target_atc
attributes.description: Target Average Transaction Count (ATC) for this service channel and daypart. Represents the expected number of items per transaction.

attributes.name: target_cover_count_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of covers (individual servings) that can be served simultaneously for this service channel and daypart, based on FOH (Front of House) and BOH (Back of House) capacity constraints.

attributes.name: target_table_turn_minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes for a table turn (time from guest seating to table availability for next guest). Applicable primarily to dine-in service channels in casual and fine-dining formats.

attributes.name: target_throughput_covers_per_hour
attributes.description: Target number of customer covers (individual servings) that should be served per hour for this service channel and daypart. Used for capacity planning and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_throughput_transactions_per_hour
attributes.description: Target number of transactions (orders) that should be processed per hour for this service channel and daypart. Used for operational performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_ticket_time_seconds
attributes.description: Target time in seconds from order placement to order fulfillment for this service channel and daypart. Key Speed of Service (SOS) metric.

attributes.name: throughput_benchmark_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the throughput benchmark record. Active = currently in use, inactive = temporarily disabled, draft = under review, archived = historical record.

products.name: sos_measurement
products.description: Transactional records of actual speed-of-service (SOS), throughput measurements, and table turn events captured per service event at each restaurant unit across all channels. For drive-thru/counter/kiosk/OLO: captures measurement timestamp, service channel, daypart, order-to-ready time, order-to-delivery time, ticket time, queue wait time, and measurement source (POS timer, KDS, sensor). For dine-in table service: captures table identifier, cover count, seating time, order-placed time, food-delivered time, check-presented time, table-cleared time, total turn time, server station, party size, and table status transitions. This is the single source of truth for all operational timing and throughput measurements across every service model. Enables unified SOS trend analysis, table turn rate optimization, cover count tracking, FOH throughput benchmarking, and benchmark gap identification.

attributes.name: sos_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each speed-of-service measurement event. Primary key for the SOS measurement transactional record.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the daypart during which this measurement occurred (breakfast, lunch, dinner, late-night). Links to daypart reference data.

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the guest order associated with this SOS measurement. Links to the order transaction record captured in the POS system.

attributes.name: sos_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where this SOS measurement was captured. Links to the restaurant master record.

attributes.name: sos_target_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the applicable SOS target benchmark for this service channel and daypart combination. Links to the SOS target reference data for variance analysis.

attributes.name: sos_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where this SOS measurement was captured. Links to the restaurant master record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOS measurement record was first created in the data system, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: equipment_issue_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether any equipment malfunction or issue was reported during this service event. True if equipment issue was logged; False otherwise.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of any exceptional circumstances that impacted service time for this measurement. Examples include equipment failure, staff shortage, system outage, or unusual order requirements.

attributes.name: guest_satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) rating provided by the guest for this service event, typically on a scale of 1-5. Captured via receipt survey, mobile app feedback, or kiosk prompt.

attributes.name: measurement_quality_score
attributes.description: Data quality score for this measurement record, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00. Reflects completeness, accuracy, and reliability of the captured timing data. Lower scores indicate potential data quality issues.

attributes.name: measurement_source
attributes.description: System or device that captured the SOS measurement. Point of Sale (POS) timer, Kitchen Display System (KDS), drive-thru sensor array, manual staff entry, Online Ordering (OLO) platform, or third-party delivery API.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the speed-of-service measurement was captured, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Represents the business event time of the service completion.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOS measurement record was last modified in the data system, in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) rating provided by the guest for this service event, typically on a scale of 0-10. Measures guest loyalty and likelihood to recommend.

attributes.name: order_complexity_score
attributes.description: Calculated complexity score for the order based on item count, customizations, and preparation requirements. Higher scores indicate more complex orders that may require longer service times.

attributes.name: order_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of menu items in the order associated with this SOS measurement. Used to analyze SOS performance relative to order complexity.

attributes.name: order_to_delivery_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from order placement to order delivered to guest. Includes preparation time plus handoff time. End-to-end service time metric.

attributes.name: order_to_ready_time_seconds
attributes.description: Elapsed time in seconds from order placement to order ready for pickup or delivery. Measured from POS order entry timestamp to Kitchen Display System (KDS) completion timestamp.

attributes.name: peak_period_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the measurement occurred during a designated peak service period. True for peak hours; False for off-peak hours.

attributes.name: queue_depth_count
attributes.description: Number of vehicles or guests in the service queue at the time of measurement. Indicates throughput capacity and congestion level.

attributes.name: queue_wait_time_seconds
attributes.description: Time in seconds the guest or vehicle spent waiting in queue before placing order. Applicable primarily to Drive-Thru (DT) and counter service channels.

attributes.name: service_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the guest order was placed and fulfilled. Drive-Thru (DT), Front of House (FOH) counter, self-service kiosk, Online Ordering (OLO), Third-Party Delivery (3PD), or curbside pickup.

attributes.name: service_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether service recovery actions were taken for this order due to SOS delays or other service failures. True if recovery actions were applied; False otherwise.

attributes.name: staff_count_on_duty
attributes.description: Number of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) staff members on duty in the service area at the time of measurement. Used to correlate staffing levels with SOS performance.

attributes.name: target_met_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the SOS measurement met or exceeded the target benchmark. True if actual time was at or below target; False if actual time exceeded target.

attributes.name: target_variance_seconds
attributes.description: Difference in seconds between actual order-to-delivery time and the SOS target benchmark. Positive values indicate slower than target; negative values indicate faster than target.

attributes.name: ticket_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds the order ticket was active in the kitchen or service queue. Represents Back of House (BOH) processing duration from ticket creation to fulfillment.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition at the restaurant location during the measurement period. Used to analyze external factors impacting drive-thru and curbside service times. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|snow|fog|wind|extreme_heat|extreme_cold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: brand_standard
products.description: Defines the brand standards and SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) applicable to each restaurant unit by concept type and ownership model. Captures standard code, standard name, standard category (food quality, cleanliness, service, safety, brand presentation), applicable format (QSR/casual/fine-dining), compliance requirement level (mandatory/recommended), effective date, expiry date, governing body reference (NRA, FDA, OSHA), and linked SOP document reference. Operational anchor for audit and compliance workflows.

attributes.name: brand_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the brand standard record. Primary key.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to restaurant.brand.brand_id

attributes.name: superseded_by_standard_brand_standard_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand_standard_id of the newer standard that replaces this one. Null if this standard is current and has not been superseded.

attributes.name: applicable_format
attributes.description: Restaurant format(s) to which this brand standard applies. QSR (Quick-Service Restaurant) for fast food, casual for casual dining, fine_dining for upscale establishments, or combinations/all formats. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|qsr|casual|fine_dining|qsr_casual|qsr_fine_dining|casual_fine_dining — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: applicable_ownership_model
attributes.description: Ownership model(s) to which this standard applies: company-owned units, franchised units, or all units regardless of ownership.

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Expected frequency at which compliance with this standard should be audited or inspected (e.g., daily temperature logs, monthly cleanliness audits, annual safety inspections). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|ad_hoc — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: brand_standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the brand standard. Active standards are in force. Inactive standards are no longer enforced. Draft standards are under development. Under_review standards are being revised. Superseded standards have been replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the external organization or authority that issues the required certification (e.g., National Restaurant Association ServSafe, OSHA, Local Health Department). Null if no certification is required.

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether staff must obtain a formal certification to perform tasks related to this standard (e.g., ServSafe Food Handler certification for food safety standards). True if certification is mandatory, False otherwise.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_level
attributes.description: Enforcement level of the standard. Mandatory standards must be met for operational compliance and are subject to audit consequences. Recommended standards are best practices encouraged but not enforced. Aspirational standards represent future-state goals.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this brand standard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this brand standard becomes active and enforceable. Standards are not applicable before this date.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this brand standard is no longer active or enforceable. Null indicates an open-ended standard with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: governing_body_reference
attributes.description: External regulatory or industry body that mandates or influences this standard (e.g., FDA, USDA, OSHA, NRA ServSafe, Local Health Department, ISO 22000). Null if the standard is purely internal.

attributes.name: guest_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this standard directly impacts the guest experience and is visible or perceptible to customers (e.g., FOH cleanliness, service speed, food presentation). True if guest-facing, False if back-of-house or internal only.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this brand standard was last reviewed for accuracy, relevance, and compliance with current regulations. Used to track review cycles and ensure standards remain current.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Method by which compliance with this standard is assessed: direct observation (visual inspection), checklist (structured audit form), measurement (thermometer, timer), testing (lab analysis, swab test), documentation review (log verification), or guest feedback (CSAT, NPS).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this brand standard. Ensures periodic reassessment to maintain relevance and regulatory alignment.

attributes.name: non_compliance_consequence
attributes.description: Consequence or remediation action triggered when a unit fails to meet this standard. Ranges from warnings and corrective action plans to financial penalties, operational suspension, or franchise termination for critical violations.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Internal department or functional area responsible for defining, maintaining, and enforcing this brand standard (e.g., Food Safety, Operations, Quality Assurance, Franchise Development, Marketing).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority level of the standard. Critical standards directly impact guest safety or regulatory compliance. High standards affect brand reputation or operational efficiency. Medium and low standards are important but less urgent.

attributes.name: sop_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the detailed SOP document that operationalizes this brand standard. May be a document management system ID, SharePoint link, or file path.

attributes.name: standard_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the brand standard into operational domains: food quality (taste, temperature, freshness), food safety (HACCP compliance, contamination prevention), cleanliness (sanitation, hygiene), service excellence (guest interaction, speed of service), brand presentation (signage, uniforms, decor), workplace safety (OSHA compliance, injury prevention), or equipment maintenance (preventive maintenance, calibration). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: food_quality|food_safety|cleanliness|service_excellence|brand_presentation|workplace_safety|equipment_maintenance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the brand standard, typically following a category-number pattern (e.g., FS-001 for Food Safety standard 001, CL-042 for Cleanliness standard 042).

attributes.name: standard_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the brand standard, including the specific requirement, rationale, and expected outcome. May reference specific procedures, thresholds, or quality criteria.

attributes.name: standard_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the brand standard (e.g., 'Proper Handwashing Protocol', 'Drive-Thru Speed of Service Target', 'Uniform and Appearance Guidelines').

attributes.name: target_metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target metric value (e.g., degrees Fahrenheit, seconds, percentage, count). Null if the standard does not have a quantitative metric.

attributes.name: target_metric_value
attributes.description: Specific quantitative or qualitative target that defines compliance with this standard (e.g., 'Food temperature >= 165°F', 'Speed of Service <= 90 seconds', 'Cleanliness score >= 95%', 'Zero critical violations'). Null if the standard is qualitative without a numeric threshold.

attributes.name: training_module_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the training module or course that covers this brand standard. May be an LMS (Learning Management System) course ID or training document reference. Null if no formal training module exists.

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal training is required for staff to understand and comply with this standard. True if training is mandatory, False otherwise.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this brand standard record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the standard, following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0). Incremented when the standard is revised or updated.

products.name: unit_performance
products.description: Periodic operational and financial performance record for each restaurant unit capturing AUV (Average Unit Volume), SSS (Same-Store Sales) growth %, comp sales (Comparable Store Sales) vs. prior period, ADT (Average Daily Transactions), ATC (Average Transaction Count), ACV (Average Check Value), COGS% (Cost of Goods Sold Percentage), Labor% (Labor Cost Percentage), Waste% (Food Waste Percentage), EBITDA, and net revenue. Sourced from Oracle MICROS POS and SAP S/4HANA. Primary performance scorecard for unit-level P&L management.

attributes.name: unit_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the unit performance record. Primary key for this periodic operational and financial performance snapshot.

attributes.name: performance_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to restaurant.performance_period. Business justification: Linking unit_performance to the master performance_period table provides a single source of period metadata and eliminates redundant date fields.

attributes.name: primary_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit for which this performance record is captured. Links to the restaurant master record.

attributes.name: acv_amount
attributes.description: Average Check Value (ACV) - average revenue per customer transaction during the performance period. Calculated as total revenue divided by transaction count.

attributes.name: adt_count
attributes.description: Average Daily Transactions (ADT) - average number of customer transactions processed per day during the performance period.

attributes.name: atc_count
attributes.description: Average Transaction Count (ATC) - total number of customer transactions during the performance period.

attributes.name: auc_amount
attributes.description: Average Unit Volume (AUV) - total revenue generated by the restaurant unit during the performance period. Key metric for unit-level revenue performance.

attributes.name: cogs_amount
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) - total cost of food and beverage inventory consumed during the performance period.

attributes.name: cogs_percent
attributes.description: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Percentage - COGS as a percentage of total revenue. Key metric for food cost management.

attributes.name: comp_sales_amount
attributes.description: Comparable Store Sales (Comp Sales) - revenue for the current period for units that were operational in both the current and prior comparison period.

attributes.name: comp_sales_variance_amount
attributes.description: Variance in Comparable Store Sales between current period and prior period, expressed as an absolute amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Record created

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this performance record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: ebitda_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Amount
attributes.description: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) - key profitability metric for unit-level P&L management.

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: Fiscal month within the fiscal year (1-12) to which this performance period belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter within the fiscal year (1, 2, 3, or 4) to which this performance period belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_week
attributes.description: Fiscal week within the fiscal year (1-52 or 1-53) to which this performance period belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this performance period belongs (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: gross_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Gross revenue before any deductions (discounts, promotions, refunds, voids) during the performance period.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total labor cost including wages, benefits, and payroll taxes for the performance period.

attributes.name: labor_percent
attributes.description: Labor Cost Percentage - total labor cost as a percentage of total revenue. Key metric for workforce efficiency.

attributes.name: marketing_expense_amount
attributes.description: Marketing and promotional expenses allocated to this unit during the performance period, including local store marketing and national campaign contributions.

attributes.name: net_income_amount
attributes.description: Net income (profit after all expenses, taxes, interest, depreciation, and amortization) for the performance period.

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Net revenue after deducting discounts, promotions, refunds, and voids during the performance period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this performance period, including explanations for anomalies, special events, or operational issues.

attributes.name: operating_income_amount
attributes.description: Operating income (revenue minus operating expenses) for the performance period. Excludes interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.

attributes.name: performance_status
attributes.description: Status of the performance record indicating whether the data is draft, preliminary, final, revised, or archived.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: rent_expense_amount
attributes.description: Rent or lease expense for the restaurant facility during the performance period. Includes base rent and Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges for leased locations.

attributes.name: rm_expense_amount
attributes.description: Repairs and Maintenance (R&M) expense for equipment, facilities, and infrastructure during the performance period.

attributes.name: sss_growth_percent
attributes.description: Same-Store Sales (SSS) growth percentage comparing current period revenue to the same period in the prior year for units open at least 12 months. Excludes new restaurant openings.

attributes.name: total_operating_expenses_amount
attributes.description: Total operating expenses including COGS, labor, utilities, rent, repairs and maintenance, and other operational costs.

attributes.name: utility_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total utility expenses (electricity, gas, water, waste disposal) during the performance period.

attributes.name: waste_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of food waste (spoilage, preparation errors, expired inventory) during the performance period.

attributes.name: waste_percent
attributes.description: Food Waste Percentage - waste cost as a percentage of total COGS. Key metric for inventory and quality management.

products.name: table_turn_log
products.description: Transactional log of table turn events at each restaurant unit capturing table identifier, cover count seated, seating time, order-placed time, food-delivered time, check-presented time, table-cleared time, total turn time (minutes), daypart, server station, and party size. Enables table turn rate analysis, cover count optimization, and FOH throughput benchmarking for casual and fine-dining formats.

attributes.name: table_turn_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each table turn event record. Primary key for the table turn log.

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking to the guest order record in the POS system. Enables correlation of table turn metrics with order details and revenue.

attributes.name: performance_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking to the specific service period definition. Provides detailed service window context beyond daypart classification.

attributes.name: table_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the server or waiter assigned to this table. Used for server performance analysis and labor productivity metrics.

attributes.name: table_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where the table turn event occurred. Links to the restaurant location profile.

attributes.name: table_server_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the server or waiter assigned to this table. Used for server performance analysis and labor productivity metrics.

attributes.name: table_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where the table turn event occurred. Links to the restaurant location profile.

attributes.name: check_presented_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the check was presented to the guest. Indicates the end of the dining experience and start of payment processing.

attributes.name: check_to_cleared_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes from check presentation to table cleared. Measures payment processing and table reset efficiency.

attributes.name: check_total_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of the check for this table turn. Used to calculate revenue per table turn and average check value (ACV) by turn time.

attributes.name: cover_count
attributes.description: Number of guests seated at the table for this turn. Critical metric for capacity planning and revenue per available seat hour (RevPASH) analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this table turn log record was created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week when the table turn occurred. Used for day-of-week table turn pattern analysis and staffing optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday|sunday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: The service period or daypart during which the table turn occurred. Used for daypart-specific table turn benchmarking and capacity planning.

attributes.name: delivery_to_check_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes from food delivery to check presentation. Represents the dining and service interaction period.

attributes.name: food_delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when food was delivered to the table. Used to calculate kitchen ticket time and overall speed of service (SOS) from order to delivery.

attributes.name: is_peak_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this table turn occurred during a peak service period (True) or off-peak (False). Used to benchmark turn times against service volume.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this table turn log record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the table turn event. May include service issues, guest requests, or operational exceptions.

attributes.name: order_placed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the guest order was placed with the server or entered into the POS (Point of Sale) system. Used to measure greeting and order-taking speed of service.

attributes.name: order_to_delivery_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes from order placement to food delivery. Measures BOH (Back of House) kitchen speed and KDS (Kitchen Display System) ticket time.

attributes.name: party_size
attributes.description: The number of guests in the dining party. May differ from cover count if party splits across multiple tables or if seats remain empty.

attributes.name: payment_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when payment was completed and processed. Marks the financial close of the table turn.

attributes.name: reservation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this table turn was for a reserved party (True) or walk-in (False). Used to analyze reservation vs walk-in turn time differences.

attributes.name: revenue_per_cover
attributes.description: Average revenue per guest cover for this table turn. Calculated as check_total_amount divided by cover_count. Key metric for per-guest revenue analysis.

attributes.name: seating_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when guests were seated at the table. Marks the start of the table turn cycle and is used to calculate total turn time.

attributes.name: seating_to_order_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes from guest seating to order placement. Measures FOH greeting and order-taking efficiency.

attributes.name: server_station
attributes.description: The FOH station or section assignment for the server handling this table. Used for workload balancing and station performance analysis.

attributes.name: sos_target_minutes
attributes.description: Target table turn time in minutes for this daypart and restaurant format. Used to measure actual performance against SOS benchmarks.

attributes.name: sos_variance_minutes
attributes.description: Variance between actual total turn time and SOS target in minutes. Positive values indicate slower than target; negative values indicate faster than target.

attributes.name: special_occasion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this table turn was for a special occasion (birthday, anniversary, celebration). Special occasions may have longer turn times due to enhanced service.

attributes.name: table_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum seating capacity of the table. Used to calculate table utilization percentage (cover_count / table_capacity).

attributes.name: table_cleared_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the table was cleared and reset for the next party. Marks the end of the table turn cycle and availability for next seating.

attributes.name: table_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier or number assigned to the table within the restaurant. Used for FOH (Front of House) table management and server station assignment.

attributes.name: table_section
attributes.description: The physical section or zone of the restaurant where the table is located (e.g., main dining, patio, bar area). Used for section-level throughput analysis.

attributes.name: total_turn_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from seating to table cleared. Primary metric for table turn rate analysis and throughput optimization. Calculated as the difference between table_cleared_timestamp and seating_timestamp.

attributes.name: turn_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the table turn occurred. Used for daily table turn rate reporting and trend analysis. May differ from seating_timestamp date for late-night service.

attributes.name: turn_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating which turn this represents for the table during the service period (1st turn, 2nd turn, etc.). Used to track table utilization throughout the day.

attributes.name: turn_status
attributes.description: Current status of the table turn event. Completed indicates normal turn cycle; incomplete indicates missing timestamps; voided indicates cancelled service; abandoned indicates guests left before service completion.

attributes.name: wait_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes that the party waited before being seated. Used to correlate wait times with table turn efficiency and guest satisfaction.

products.name: capacity_config
products.description: Defines the seating and service capacity configuration for each restaurant unit including total indoor seating capacity, outdoor/patio seating capacity, bar seating count, private dining room capacity, drive-thru stacking capacity (number of vehicles), kiosk count, counter service positions, maximum cover count per daypart, and ADA-compliant seating count. Used for throughput planning, labor staffing ratios, and health department permit compliance.

attributes.name: capacity_config_id

attributes.name: capacity_restaurant_unit_id

attributes.name: capacity_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit to which this capacity configuration applies.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_seating_count

attributes.description: Number of seating positions that meet ADA accessibility requirements for guests with disabilities.

attributes.name: avg_party_size
attributes.description: Average number of guests per dining party used for capacity planning and labor forecasting.

attributes.name: bar_seating_count
attributes.description: Number of seats available at the bar or counter service area.

attributes.name: config_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this capacity configuration becomes effective for the restaurant unit.

attributes.name: config_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this capacity configuration ceases to be effective. Null indicates the configuration is currently active.

attributes.name: config_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special considerations, constraints, or context for this capacity configuration.

attributes.name: config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capacity configuration record.

attributes.name: counter_service_positions
attributes.description: Number of staffed counter service positions available for order taking and guest interaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: curbside_pickup_spaces
attributes.description: Number of designated parking spaces available for curbside pickup and online ordering (OLO) fulfillment.

attributes.name: delivery_staging_capacity
attributes.description: Number of completed delivery orders that can be staged simultaneously in the designated pickup area for third-party delivery (3PD) drivers.

attributes.name: drive_thru_sos_target_seconds
attributes.description: Target time in seconds for drive-thru order fulfillment from order point to pickup window.

attributes.name: drive_thru_stacking_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles that can queue in the drive-thru lane before reaching the order point.

attributes.name: fire_code_occupancy_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of occupants (guests and staff) permitted in the facility as determined by local fire safety regulations.

attributes.name: health_permit_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum seating capacity approved by the local health department on the restaurant operating permit.

attributes.name: indoor_seating_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of indoor seats available for guest dining in the Front of House (FOH) area.

attributes.name: kiosk_count
attributes.description: Number of self-service ordering kiosks available in the Front of House (FOH) for guest order placement.

attributes.name: kitchen_production_capacity_orders_per_hour
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders the Back of House (BOH) kitchen can produce per hour at full operational capacity.

attributes.name: labor_staffing_ratio
attributes.description: Target ratio of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) staff to seating capacity or covers, used for workforce scheduling and labor cost planning.

attributes.name: max_cover_count_breakfast
attributes.description: Maximum number of guest covers (individual diners) that can be served during the breakfast daypart based on seating and throughput capacity.

attributes.name: max_cover_count_dinner
attributes.description: Maximum number of guest covers that can be served during the dinner daypart based on seating and throughput capacity.

attributes.name: max_cover_count_late_night
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Cover Count - Late Night Daypart
attributes.description: Maximum number of guest covers that can be served during the late night daypart based on seating and throughput capacity.

tag_set.value: Maximum Cover Count - Late Night Daypart

attributes.name: max_cover_count_lunch
attributes.description: Maximum number of guest covers that can be served during the lunch daypart based on seating and throughput capacity.

attributes.name: outdoor_seating_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of outdoor or patio seats available for guest dining.

attributes.name: peak_hour_throughput_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of guest transactions or covers that can be processed during the busiest hour of operation.

attributes.name: private_dining_capacity
attributes.description: Total seating capacity in private dining rooms or event spaces within the restaurant.

attributes.name: sos_target_seconds
attributes.description: Target time in seconds from order placement to order delivery, used as a key operational performance metric.

attributes.name: table_turn_target_minutes
attributes.description: Target time in minutes for a complete table turn cycle from guest seating to table reset for the next guest.

attributes.name: total_seating_capacity
attributes.description: Aggregate seating capacity across all dining areas including indoor, outdoor, bar, and private dining.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity configuration record was last modified.

products.name: unit_status_history
products.description: Tracks the full lifecycle status history of each restaurant unit including status transitions (active, temporarily closed, permanently closed, under renovation, pre-opening, soft-open, NRO new restaurant opening), effective date of each status change, reason code, change initiated by (franchise partner, corporate operations, health department), and expected reopen date where applicable. Provides audit trail for unit lifecycle management and SSS eligibility determination.

attributes.name: unit_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each unit status history record. Primary key for the unit status history tracking entity.

attributes.name: primary_restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit to which this status history record applies. Links to the master restaurant entity.

attributes.name: unit_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the individual who recorded or approved the status change. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: unit_initiated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the individual who recorded or approved the status change. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: actual_reopen_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the restaurant unit returned to active status. Used to measure variance against expected reopen date and assess project execution.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the status change was formally approved by the appropriate authority. Null if no approval was required or approval is still pending.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status change required formal approval from corporate leadership, franchise partner, or regulatory authority before implementation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role that approved the status change. Used for governance and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: closure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the closure event distinguishing between planned maintenance closures, emergency shutdowns, regulatory actions, and other closure scenarios. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|unplanned|emergency|seasonal|regulatory|voluntary|involuntary — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing compliance-related information associated with the status change, including regulatory requirements, corrective actions, or legal considerations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The created timestamp attribute value for this unit status history record in the restaurant domain

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this status became effective for the restaurant unit. Used to determine SSS eligibility windows and operational reporting periods.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this status ceased to be effective, marking the transition to the next status. Null for the current active status record.

attributes.name: estimated_revenue_impact
attributes.description: Projected financial impact on unit revenue during the status period, expressed in local currency. Used for financial planning and P&L forecasting.

attributes.name: expected_reopen_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date when the restaurant unit is expected to return to active status following a temporary closure or renovation. Null if not applicable or unknown.

attributes.name: grand_opening_date
attributes.description: Official grand opening date for the restaurant unit. Marks the beginning of full operational status and SSS eligibility countdown.

attributes.name: health_department_case_number
attributes.description: Official case or incident number assigned by the local health department if the status change was triggered by a health inspection failure or food safety violation.

attributes.name: impact_on_franchise_agreement
attributes.description: Description of how this status change affects the franchise agreement terms, royalty obligations, or compliance requirements. Relevant for franchise partner relations and legal review.

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: The party or department that initiated the status change. Identifies accountability and decision authority for lifecycle transitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate_operations|franchise_partner|health_department|real_estate|finance|legal|system — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_sss_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the restaurant unit is eligible for inclusion in Same-Store Sales (SSS) calculations during this status period. Typically requires 12+ months of continuous active operation.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when formal notification of the status change was communicated to relevant stakeholders including franchise partners, corporate operations, and regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: nro_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status record is associated with a New Restaurant Opening (NRO) event. Used to track grand opening milestones and ramp-up performance.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The status of the restaurant unit immediately prior to this status change. Enables transition analysis and lifecycle pattern identification.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the status change. Examples include health_violation, lease_expiration, remodel, nro_launch, seasonal_closure, natural_disaster, underperformance, franchise_termination.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the reason for the status change. Provides context beyond the standardized reason code for audit and operational review.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this status history record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when this status history record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: renovation_scope
attributes.description: Classification of the renovation or remodel scope when the status change is related to facility improvements. Impacts expected duration and capital expenditure (CapEx) tracking.

attributes.name: restaurant_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the restaurant unit. Human-readable store number used in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: soft_open_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the restaurant unit began soft-open operations prior to the official grand opening. Used to track pre-launch performance and operational readiness.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this status history record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: unit_status_history_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the restaurant unit at this point in the lifecycle. Determines eligibility for Same-Store Sales (SSS) calculations and operational reporting.

products.name: ops_visit_finding

attributes.name: ops_visit_finding_id

attributes.name: ops_unit_id

attributes.name: ops_visit_id

attributes.description: Reference to the ops_visit_finding_id of the prior occurrence if this is a repeat finding. Enables tracking of finding recurrence patterns and corrective action effectiveness.

attributes.description: Name of the manager or executive who approved the waiver. Populated only when status is waived. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required corrective action has been completed and verified. True when action is complete and verified; False when pending or in progress.

attributes.name: corrective_action_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the corrective action was completed and verified. Populated when corrective_action_completed_flag is set to True. Used to calculate resolution time and track overdue items.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the corrective action must be completed. Set based on severity level: critical findings typically require same-day or next-day resolution, major findings within 7 days, minor findings within 30 days.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action that must be taken to resolve the finding. Specifies what needs to be done, by whom, and any specific requirements or standards that must be met.

attributes.name: corrective_action_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify that the corrective action was completed satisfactorily. Options include on-site inspection by field manager, photographic evidence submitted by unit, document review, manager attestation, or scheduled follow-up visit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this finding record was first created in the system. System-generated audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Organizational level to which this finding has been escalated. Unit: handled at restaurant level. Area: escalated to area manager. Region: escalated to regional director. Corporate: escalated to corporate compliance or executive leadership.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding requires escalation beyond the restaurant unit level to area management, regional leadership, or corporate compliance. True for critical findings, repeat major findings, or regulatory violations requiring senior leadership notification.

attributes.name: financial_impact_usd
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the finding in US dollars. May include cost of waste, potential fines, equipment repair costs, or revenue impact from service disruption. Used for prioritization and ROI analysis of corrective actions.

attributes.name: finding_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the finding type. Categories include food safety (HACCP violations, temperature control), cleanliness (sanitation, hygiene), equipment (maintenance, functionality), service (guest experience, speed of service), brand standard (SOP compliance, visual standards), labor (staffing, scheduling, training), and inventory (stock levels, waste management). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: food_safety|cleanliness|equipment|service|brand_standard|labor|inventory — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the observed finding. Captures what was observed, where it was observed, and the specific condition or behavior that triggered the finding. Free-text field for auditor notes.

attributes.name: finding_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of findings within the parent visit. Used to maintain the order in which findings were recorded during the field visit.

attributes.name: finding_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the finding category. Examples: temperature_control, hand_washing, equipment_calibration, uniform_compliance, waste_tracking. Provides granular segmentation for trend analysis.

attributes.name: finding_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the finding was observed and recorded during the field visit. Captures the precise moment of observation for time-sensitive findings such as temperature violations or service delays.

attributes.name: guest_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding has direct impact on guest experience, satisfaction, or safety. True if the finding affects FOH (Front of House) operations, service quality, food safety, or guest-facing brand standards; False if it is purely BOH (Back of House) or administrative.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this finding record was last updated. System-generated audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, context, or observations related to the finding. May include mitigating circumstances, root cause analysis, or special instructions for corrective action.

attributes.name: ops_visit_finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the finding. Open: newly recorded, awaiting action. In Progress: corrective action underway. Resolved: action completed, awaiting verification. Closed: verified and complete. Waived: finding acknowledged but action waived with justification.

attributes.name: photo_evidence_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to photographic evidence documenting the finding. Used for visual verification, training purposes, and dispute resolution. Links to document management system or cloud storage.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulatory code, section, or requirement that was violated. Examples: FDA Food Code 3-501.16, OSHA 1910.22, Local Health Code Section 12.4. Populated only when regulatory_violation_flag is True.

attributes.name: regulatory_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding constitutes a violation of regulatory requirements (FDA, OSHA, local health department). True if the finding violates a legal or regulatory standard; False if it is an internal brand standard deviation only.

attributes.name: repeat_finding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding is a repeat of a previously identified issue at this restaurant unit. True if the same or similar finding was recorded in a prior visit; False if this is the first occurrence. Used to identify systemic compliance gaps.

attributes.name: repeat_occurrence_count
attributes.description: Number of times this specific finding has been recorded at this restaurant unit. Incremented each time the same finding is observed in subsequent visits. Used for escalation and intervention triggers.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual assigned responsibility for completing the corrective action. Typically the restaurant general manager, area manager, or specific department lead depending on the finding category.

attributes.name: responsible_party_role
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual responsible for the corrective action. Examples: General Manager, Kitchen Manager, Area Manager, Facilities Manager, Training Coordinator.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Classification of the finding's impact and urgency. Critical: immediate health/safety risk or major brand violation requiring immediate action. Major: significant compliance gap with potential regulatory or brand impact. Minor: deviation from standard with limited impact. Observation: opportunity for improvement without compliance violation.

attributes.name: waiver_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the waiver was approved. Populated only when status is waived.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Justification for waiving the corrective action requirement. Populated only when status is waived. Requires approval from authorized manager and documentation of business rationale.
